neighbours.label: a token that restarts the word just before it: a model code beginning with the brand's own initial (Yamaha Y…, Nitto NT…, Broadcom BCM…) or a repeated path / module segment (/admin/admin, stock.stock); a code or segment with a different initial is quiet
